title: Google Sheets and WhatsApp Integration
seoTitle: Google Sheets to WhatsApp: Send Reminders From a Spreadsheet
seoDescription: Send WhatsApp template messages from a Google Sheet: reminders, confirmations and updates, with status written back. Set-up, consent and limits.
summary: A Google Sheets–WhatsApp integration sends approved WhatsApp template messages to rows in a sheet, such as fee reminders, appointment confirmations or dispatch updates, and writes the delivery status back to the sheet. It is a practical automation for teams already running a process in a spreadsheet.

dataPoints.label: Sheets side
dataPoints.value: Google Sheets API with a fixed layout and a status column

dataPoints.label: WhatsApp side
dataPoints.value: Cloud API with approved templates and variables mapped to columns

dataPoints.label: Status back
dataPoints.value: Sent, delivered, read or failed, with timestamps

dataPoints.label: Safeguards
dataPoints.value: Opt-in column, daily sending limits, no duplicate sends

body:
## How it works

1. A row is marked ready, for example a due date reached.
2. The integration sends the template with that row's values.
3. Delivery status is written back to the row.
4. Replies can be routed to a shared inbox.

## When to move beyond a sheet

If several people edit the sheet and mistakes send wrong messages, a small internal tool with validation is safer. See [internal tools](/blog/internal-tools-the-highest-return-software-most-businesses-never-build).

faqs.q: Can I send to people who have not opted in?
faqs.a: No. Keep an opt-in column and send only to those who agreed.
Meta applies messaging limits that increase as your number builds a good quality rating.
